messages:
maya: FYI our int8 canary (raven-lite q4a) is showing more funcall parse failures on streaming vs non-streaming. +1.9% raw parse fail in the window.
oliver: do we have logs pointing to truncation vs tokenization?
sam: logs indicate streaming flush cuts inside JSON array suffix. example:
```
..."actions":[{"name":"lookup","args":{...}},
<STREAM_CUTOFF>
```
parser sees incomplete object
maya: non-streaming/gRPC path fine. points to streaming aggregator/batching interaction
sophia: could be batch flush timing + rate limiter bursting. similar pattern to past kv-prefix truncation but different suffix
oliver: can we reproduce with a stress harness toggling rate_cap and batch_max_tokens? i'll try small matrix
sam: repro I used:
```
rcli canary run --model raven-lite-q4a --mode streaming --qps 30 --duration 10m --payload samples/fncall-heavy.json
rcli metrics slice --canary run123 --metric funcall_parse_fail
```
maya: quick mitigation idea: append sentinel token to prompt like <JSON_TERMINATOR> and strip client-side before parse. quick to test
sophia: prefer runtime fix: flush streamer on likely funcall suffix patterns (detect "']}, or array terminators). needs perf check
oliver: sentinel vs runtime tweak. run both canaries in parallel and compare funcall_parse_fail, p99-token-loss, token_delta, cpu_alloc
deploy-bot: deploy started: canary/stream-sentinel-probe v0.1 -> canary cluster
sam: sentinel patch:
```
prompt = prompt + "\\n<JSON_TERMINATOR>"
// client: strip from first occurrence of <JSON_TERMINATOR>
```
maya: sentinel run (20k req) -> parse fail 3.2% -> 0.6%, but token usage +0.8%
oliver: acceptable cost for reliability? ensure tools don't see sentinel (we strip pre-invoke)
sophia: also try lowering batch_max_tokens by 20% for streaming funcall routes; should reduce mid-object flushes without adding tokens
maya: agreed. run two canaries: sentinel vs reduced-batch. collect the metrics listed
sam: kicking them off, will report in ~45m
oliver: if sentinel wins but cost too high, implement smart flush in runtime next. :thumbsup:
maya: adding note to canary playbook and flagging for eng-ml retro
sophia: logs/results uploaded to s3://redwood-canaries/6139991111/ and results.json linked
deploy-bot: canary run123 finished: 45m, status completed
sam: quick summary: sentinel reduced parse fails significantly but increased token cost; reduced-batch reduced failures and cost moderately. next: prototype runtime flush patch and perf bench
oliver: filing follow-up phab ticket T12345 to track runtime flush and monitoring
sophia: request adding alert: funcall parse delta >0.5% over baseline
maya: noted and will add to monitoring playbook :white_check_mark:
